_about: Known right answers for the URL intake, from sites we have checked by hand. The eval runs a draft per site and scores it; it never confirms anything. Add a site when a run teaches us something general — the point is a number that moves, not a rule per site.

sites.why: Two headed sections on /artists: 'Fellowship Artists' (represented, 6) and 'Exhibited Artists' (everyone else, incl. estates). Sept 2026: 66 REPRESENTS recorded, 65 citing one /about-us sentence.
A project gallery / dealership / advisory: 'Artists (project)' is not representation. 16 works; Molnar, Nake, Nees share two shows.

A platform: series organised by others (Fakewhale) on it. The subject must end up connected. Sept 24 eval: connected (16 series PRESENTED_BY Verse + organiser) but 0 artworks proposed — min_works keeps '0 of 0 images' from passing.

One artist's own site. Series pages name many works but show 1–3 images each, so most named works have no picture on the site (checked Sept 24: /in-silico names 5 works, shows 3 images). Sept 24 eval: 7 of 26.
